question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required if the sentence is correct as given.

The driver cracked his whip and called to his horses, (and off they swept on their way) to Bukovina.

options.text: and of they swept on their way
and off they swept on there way
and off they sweep on their way

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is **grammatically correct as it stands.**
 
• The phrase **"and off they swept on their way"** is correctly constructed and does not require any changes.
 
• The options provided contain **grammatical errors** or incorrect word usage.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **"No correction required".**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

Correct Sentence**:** *"**The driver cracked his whip and called to his horses, and off they swept on their way to Bukovina."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "and of they swept on their way"** – This option is incorrect because "of" is not the correct preposition in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "and off they swept on there way"** – This option is incorrect because "there" is a homophone and should be "their" to indicate possession.
 
• **Option 4: "and off they sweep on their way"** – This option is incorrect because "sweep" should be in the past tense "swept" to match the past tense of the narrative.
